title: Gatefold quick-launch visual heuristic and screenshot stories
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Objective: Refresh the Quickstart landing visuals with a gatefold-style hero, compact step rail, and standardized screenshot stories for product releases. This ticket covers the visual heuristic, sample screenshots pipeline, and the first-pass export-ready assets for the docs and marketing teams.

Background: The current quickstart hero and step visuals are inconsistent across docs and console. Recent user testing (internal beta) surfaced confusion around the entry point and sequence of steps for new users. We want a single visual language that scales between marketing hero, in-app quickstart panel, and the docs welcome page.

Goals:
- Create a gatefold hero treatment (left: value proposition + CTA, right: interactive device mockup) that reads well on 1280px down to 360px breakpoints.
- Produce 6 screenshot stories (3 desktop, 3 mobile) that illustrate the 3 primary onboarding steps with consistent annotations and copy.
- Provide export-ready artboards for Docs (1200x600), Console header (1440x360), and Marketing hero (1600x720).
- Ensure WCAG AA contrast and accessible typography tokens.
- Deliver design handoff and checklist for engineering to implement responsive hero and screenshot carousel.
acceptance_criteria: Gatefold hero artboard approved by PM and Product Design lead
Six screenshot stories exported in PNG and SVG with naming convention quickstart_step-<n>_<device>.png
Responsive specs in Figma with layout tokens and breakpoint notes (desktop/tablet/mobile)
Accessibility checklist passed (contrast ratios, alt text spec, keyboard focus order)
Design handoff page with dev tickets for Console and Docs (linked PRs or tickets)
tasks: Research: audit existing quickstart assets across docs and console (link below)
Concept: sketch 3 gatefold compositional options and present to PM
Design: high-fidelity gatefold hero and step-rail components in Figma
Screenshot pipeline: create guided script and device frames for consistent captures
Export: output final artboards and screenshot story exports (PNG, SVG)
Handoff: populate Figma handoff, tokens, and example CSS snippets; tag engineering
Post-review: iterate on feedback from engineering QA and accessibility review
review_history: 2026-03-04 - PM review by Arjun Patel: prefers stronger call-to-action and reduced copy length on hero left pane
2026-03-06 - Engineering sync with Samir Khatri (ENG): confirmed carousel support and requested 3:2 device artboards
2026-03-08 - Accessibility review by Priya Rao: flagged button contrast and suggested 18px minimum body size on mobile
2026-03-11 - Design critique with team: selected gatefold variant C; requested alternate colorways for dark mode
notes: Design tradeoffs: gatefold enables stronger storytelling but requires careful mobile collapse behavior — propose collapsing device mockup into stacked cards under 520px.
Screenshot pipeline: use Cypress visual-capture script to generate canonical PNGs; recipe stored in drive attachment.
Implementation hint: engineering prefers a single responsive component with CSS grid and overlap mask for device frame to avoid multiple assets.
Follow-ups: schedule 30-minute QA walkthrough with docs engineers once PR is opened (owner: Lena).
